why_agent_cannot: the drop requires a Telegram or Discord account session
what_human_must_do: Check that real-money gaming is legal where you live. We couldn't read Cambria's terms (see below).
Create an account in the Cambria lobby (referral link) with a wallet, email or social login.
Buy keys with USDC and play Dungeons runs to earn Royal Favor. Warning This is wagering with real money. Once keys are risked on a run, you can get back less than you put in.
Watch Cambria's blog and X account for the token and Genesis dates.
costs: Earning points means risking money. A key costs $0.10 in USDC, and a run can currently risk up to 50 keys, about $5. Unrisked keys can be swapped back for USDC at face value. Cambria's Dungeons economics docs page on 18 October 2026, with the flow from a USDC deposit to keys, runs, Dungeon Coins and a weekly redemption. Source: Cambria docs
risks: This is wagering. BlockchainGamerBiz reported that 87% of the $41 million wagered in the Genesis event went through Dungeon Fishing, a mode it calls gambling-heavy. The terms of service link in Cambria's docs redirects to the lobby, so we couldn't check its age limit or excluded countries. Cambria hasn't said what happens to the game, or to keys and balances, when Abstract shuts down on 15 Decembe
